scope: Actual shared StepGameplay, real waves/bosses, XP/drops, offered upgrades and mutations, merchant budget, normal difficulty, mastery I and no shop upgrades. Bot inputs, isolated PlayerPrefs. Not human win rates, subjective fun, exhaustive builds, Android FPS or meta-completion balance.

isolation.scope: Isolated typed reads/writes/delete/save, nested exception restoration, real active-save unchanged, duplicate deferred destroy boundary.

frame-equivalence.scope: Per-frame production Update versus shared headless step with idle input: HP/position, progression, wave timers, RNG, sphere cadence, enemy states, active agent birth/death/positions; camera presentation excluded.

cosmetics-equivalence.scope: Actual collector world/economy/progression, up to 300s or death: identical game RNG/outcomes/history/samples/positions with regular vs early-retired cosmetic particles; no player quality setting changed.

snapshot-guard.scope: Actual CaptureRunSnapshot excludes the transient Triangle reentrancy guard, retains gameplay/RNG; production field filter ignores the guard in historical snapshots.

boss-scaling.scope: Actual campaign boss creation with fixed wave versus fixed clock; diagnostics only, no stat overrides or new tuning.

trials.scope: Production gameplay phases at 60Hz, normal difficulty, empty meta upgrades/mastery I, isolated access flags, legal offered upgrades/placements, actual pickups/merchant, bot input; not human win rate, player enjoyment or Android performance.
